CAROUSEL 4 — rev B

Four stations, motor-driven, pods sized to the Volcano's own Ø30 screen so the deepest setting holds a complete stock bowl.

Host figures came from retailer and support listings — the manufacturer's own pages would not load from this machine. Every interface dimension still has to be measured off a real device before anything gets cut.
Start here if you want something on the bench soonest. Route B needs one reducer sleeve and no custom pods — the disc, cam, seals and drive are identical either way.
